decisions.reason: As a newly launched, website-promoted underground mining machine that fits the firm's engineering-heavy and safety-focused strategy, it is likely to be retained because development costs and public commitment are already substantial and any weak early uptake can still be seen as temporary.

This newly introduced underground mining dump truck also sits close to the firm's core specialized-equipment business, so management is likely to keep it on the market since investment and visible commitment have already been made and first-year results in such capital goods markets are usually not decisive.
